title: DB-045(a) bridge-mount precondition validation: real MapPLUTO parcel pairs (display 4326 vs authoritative 2263 rings) measured for vertex-count equality + 2.0-ft RMS correspondence on recorded fixtures BEFORE any mount

FIXTURE CAPTURE (binding): capture >=8 real parcel pairs spanning >=3 boroughs and geometry classes (regular small lot; many-vertex irregular; waterfront/curved-edge; large assemblage/through-lot) through BOTH connectors' documented endpoints; store each response verbatim under services/api/tests/connectors/fixtures/bridge_ring_pairs/ with a provenance record per pair (endpoint URL, BBL, retrieved_at UTC, response sha256, dataset version if disclosed). outputs: Recorded real-pair fixture pack with per-pair provenance under services/api/tests/connectors/fixtures/bridge_ring_pairs/

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (fixtures + provenance): >=8 real parcel pairs, >=3 boroughs, the named geometry classes, captured through BOTH accepted connectors and stored verbatim with per-pair provenance (endpoint, BBL, retrieved_at, sha256); every test runs offline on the fixtures; the provenance record round-trips in the harness output.

AS-4 (no production change): zero edits outside allowed_paths; no new dependency; connectors imported read-only; ruff clean; modularity check clean.
